title: docs(qa): re-point the wave-5 checklist lines and add the package export round-trip item
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiNjyvCdXYygFqntMNR7S2dW)_

Fixes #29906

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按 18.3.0 第五轮复测（#29890、#29893、#29877、#29870）的发现，更新了 45 个测试清单条目和 RUNNER 说明，并新增 1 个条目，覆盖“整个部署导出、到新环境再安装”这条链路。
- 为什么改：这些步骤和判定写的还是旧行为。下一轮测试照着跑，会把正常行为误判为失败，或者白白多出 422 和卡住的步骤。
- 风险与回滚：只改了 docs/qa 下的清单 JSON 和 RUNNER.md，产品代码没有动。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。
- 先看：RUNNER.md 新写的两条环境事实，一条是覆盖已发布视图或模板的方式（走 .custom 定制包），一条是首次进入时的币种/时区弹窗；再看新条目 platform-core.package-export-round-trip。
- 两分钟验证：在分支上运行 `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`，应返回 OK，退出码 0。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## What changes

Each card line was re-read against the code at base `f68b47ca` before it was applied. 45 existing items get a revision bump and a history row that cites #29906; one item is new.

- **Part A (W5-FAIL, #29890): 19 items.**
  - The aggregate bulk action goes through the action door, `POST /api/v1/actions/showcase_task/showcase_recalc_selection` with `{params:{_selectedIds}}`.
  - ADR-0146 D11 pair staging: list-view negatives and the email-template admin edit.
  - `/batch` is no longer offered as a 400 door.
  - `connectorConfig` is closed, and run records hold echoed secrets.
  - Email: the non-string display name probe, the `failed` row after a refused send, the unreachable no-locale branch and `?member=`.
  - Flow clone: 11 dropped keys, and the 'Added' row mark beside the 'In {pair}' header chip.
  - 'Switched on / off for this deployment'.
  - The New flow dialog is proven by creating a flow.
  - The app-id canonicalisation hop, and Keyboard shortcuts only inside an app.
  - No Activity tab for a member.
  - surface-matrix: `--maxWorkers=1`, a field-help variant, and a stock zh confirm specimen (`sys_session.revoke_my_other_sessions`, read from source only).
  - adhoc: a quick search, and sign-out through the account menu.
  - Dashboard: the wave-4 held filter shape, and a two-dimension sankey with no root.
  - `?mode=draft` on a read answers 400.
  - The no-entry matrix: lockedBy (#29312), the sortable observables (#29896, #30024), non-default probes, `modalSize` and the CEL envelope.
  - `sharingModel` for a published fixture object.
  - disabled-control: Archive's own reason, the ledger switch, the ~all item page (#29897).
  - Invite outcome copy, and the per-group approval read from `sys_approval_action`.
  - PERMISSION_DENIED vs FORBIDDEN for the same `manage_metadata` refusal.
- **Part B (W5-STUDIO, #29893): 24 studio-authoring items.**
  - Studio routes for the picklist fixture, the scratch-copy boot and the Add record dialog.
  - Spelled-out values for `indexes` and `contextSelectors`.
  - Autosave wording.
  - Validation rule shapes.
  - Script action capabilities.
  - 'New dataset' exists.
  - The joined report hold.
  - Record page autosave, and the member leg driven.
  - The command-center queue filter, a planted foreign task, Display › Layout and the publish door.
  - The sealed-sentence scope.
  - Dataset plus measure.
  - Leave-guard label and user activation.
  - 'Switched on / off'.
  - The edge Condition control.
  - The qualified view name.
  - The pair link lands on the base.
  - RLS operation `select`.
  - Clear falls back to the object grant.
  - Ensure is asked once per editing session.
- **Part C (W5-P0, #29877).** `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` knownGaps[3] becomes a regression row (#29673 is fixed by #29790). RUNNER's console-auth fact names the Packaged Actions page; the retired Packaged Automation page now redirects to Studio.
- **Part D (W5-EXPORT, #29870).** New `platform-core.package-export-round-trip` (api + cli, P1, v18.3, active), with 7 acceptance clauses, 5 negatives, source anchors and partial automated pins. Clauses [3] and [6] cite #29871 and #29872 as **fixed**: both are closed completed at base, so the clauses state the fixed behaviour and name the card a regression would reopen.
- **RUNNER.md.**
  - The "`view` is overlay-allowed, a bare PUT answers 2xx" fact is replaced by the D11 rule. A package-less write onto a shipped name answers 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE; the recipe is ensure-customization, then PUT `?package=com.example.showcase.custom` with `overrides`; a fresh name still writes.
  - A new fact covers the first-page currency / timezone prompt (`workspace-timezone-prompt-decline`, 'Not now'). This also lands the card's "all page items" fixture line.
- **Deviation, not on the card.** `platform-core.manifest-install-contract` source[1] is re-pointed from `protocol.ts#assertProtocolCompat`, which no longer resolves, to `protocol-package-install.ts#installPackage`. The checker refused `platform-core.json` at base for this anchor, and this PR edits that file.

**Overlap with #29819.** The `studio-authoring.picklist-bound-select` fixture line (`fixtures.requires[0]`: the scratch copy and no `--compile`) lands here, so #29819 should skip it.

**Lines not applied** (6 of the card's 66):
- `offclause.zh-cn-studio-save-29790`, all 4 lines: no ledger item carries this off-clause, so there is nothing to re-point.
- `studio-authoring.org-scope-flows` fixtures.requires[1]: a confirmation, and the ledger already says it. At base a fresh-name package-less PUT still writes and a shipped name answers 403, so no change.
- `studio-authoring.permission-matrix-editor-ux` A5: the card says the metadata-admin door draws no object expander on a read-only set. At base, `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` draws the chevron expander on every object row of that door with no read-only gate, so the reading could not be confirmed and the clause is unchanged.

**Lines where the code at base differs from the card, applied as the code reads** (8):
- held-edit-leave-guard: the card's steps[2] is steps[1] at base.
- picklist-bound-select: steps[4] names no route, so it is unchanged.
- report-authoring-options: only steps[2] has a Joined switch; steps[0] is unchanged.
- `modalSize`: the record modal's form view is the default form, or the `create` form view for a create, not only the "isDefault" form.
- Email locale: the channel names the recipient's `sys_user.locale`, else the deployment default, rather than always `en`.
- Part D [3] and [6] are fixed rather than failing.
- The Packaged Automation fact is re-pointed to its successor, Packaged Actions, from source.
- The "all page items" currency line lands as one RUNNER fact plus `app-and-nav-properties` steps[1], not on each page item.

## Tests

Documentation and checklist only; no product code or test changes. The ledger is validated by `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`. Every edit was applied text-level, then re-parsed and deep-compared against the intended object before it was written.

## Acceptance notes

- Every line was re-read at base `f68b47ca` before it was applied; the skipped and changed lines are named above.
- Part D lands with `status: active` and its pins. The two clauses the card proposed as failing cite #29871 and #29872, both closed completed.
- No line-number citations were added. Every `file#symbol` anchor added resolves to a declaration, and no anchor was removed.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` → exit 0 (16 areas, 360 items).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 16 commands, and all 16 ran → exit 0.
  - `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 because a prerequisite was not built. I ran the build it prescribes (`turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`), and the gate then exited 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a derived zero, from recorded exit codes).
- `origin/main` merged once before opening (merge `97ee2c53`).
